info.title: UnlockPressure x402 Paid API
info.description: Source-backed token unlock sell-pressure intelligence, paid per call with x402 on Base USDC.

get.description: Returns upcoming unlock events with modeled sell-pressure risk after x402 settlement.

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: Legacy x402 payment signature produced by a Base/EVM x402 client after reading the 402 challenge.

parameters.name: X-PAYMENT
parameters.description: Base64url-encoded x402 payment payload for Base mainnet USDC; send on the paid retry after receiving the 402 challenge.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional caller-generated key used to deduplicate paid retries for the same request.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Forward-looking unlock window in days. Use 90 for the first wallet-paid ping.

parameters.name: minRisk
parameters.description: Minimum modeled risk score. Use 70 for the first wallet-paid ping.

402.description: x402 payment required. Read PAYMENT-REQUIRED, create a Base USDC proof, and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or X-PAYMENT. The JSON body also includes route-specific buyer instructions and examples.

minRisk.description: Minimum modeled unlock pressure risk score to include.
Minimum modeled unlock pressure risk score to include.
Minimum modeled unlock pressure risk score to include.

post.description: Scores one token unlock event using source confidence, liquidity context, and unlock size.
